96.qualification: Analytic dense MACs before constant folding; excludes elementwise arithmetic, reductions, padding, transfers, and compiler tiling. One MAC counts as two FLOPs.

host_overhead_note: Excludes backend/RPC/buffer overhead inside Module.forward; paired per-request subtraction.
